result: Exact structural observability of the Q2 statewise continuation-count future by last-four block-profile family sums.

last4_rational_conclusion.reason: The measurement matrix has integer entries. A full-rank minor modulo an odd prime has determinant nonzero over the integers, hence over Q. The target rational dimensions are independently exact.

minimal_window_within_tested_recent_prof.proof: For lengths 1,2,3 the number of realized measurement groups is respectively 12,130,711, all below the exact full future dimension 1179, so injectivity is impossible. Length 4 achieves rank 1179.

primal_dual_separation.known_primal_counterexample: Two Q2 states can share exact current legal response and ordered last-five complete-block profiles yet have different persistent continuation counts.
primal_dual_separation.interpretation: Recent profile fibers are not predictive states, but aggregate sums over last-four-profile fibers form complete linear measurements of the exact Q2 future-function space.

classical_boundary: The abstract rank/observability/Hankel-basis principle is classical in weighted automata, observable operator models, and predictive state representations. The Abelian-specific result is the concrete low-complexity profile-family measurement system.
